services.name: Reserve Your Charter
services.desc: During the Spring and Summer months, Charleston’s nearshore reefs, wrecks, and beaches come alive with migratory species. Anglers can expect to catch wahoo, tuna, sailfish, and mahi mahi while trolling the ledge. While kingfish,cobia, amberjack, barracuda, snapper, grouper, triggerfish, spadefish, sheepshead, and black sea bass are abundant around wrecks and live bottom areas. On the beaches and areas surrounding the Charleston Harbor, you’ll find bull redfish (20-40 lbs), tarpon, flounder, sharks, and much more. All nearshore and offshore trips are conducted on a 27-foot Conch center console powered by twin Yamaha 200s, a proven fishing machine designed for both comfort and performance.
